title: Infoblox confirms a security incident traced to an outside vendor
summary: Infoblox, a company that sells network security products, confirmed that someone gained unauthorized access to certain company information. A spokesperson told TechCrunch the access came through a compromised third-party data migration vendor and that the company is investigating. The incident is a reminder that a breach can start with a supplier and not with the company itself.
why: Ask the vendors that handle your data how they protect it, and limit what each one can reach.
